heroes.name: Lifeweaver

changes.note: Fixed a bug where Healing Blossom would release unexpectedly when switching weapons.

heroes.summary: This correction eliminates accidental discharge of healing charges, improving control and reliability when alternating between damage and support modes.

heroes.name: Mercy

changes.note: Fixed an issue where Mercy was gaining increased self-healing from the Medic Subrole.

heroes.summary: Removing the unintended self-healing bonus brings Mercy’s survivability back in line with intended subrole tuning, slightly increasing her vulnerability to focus fire.
